task: Develop TorchScript DeepLOB (CNN+LSTM) with OFI Alpha and PyTorch-Native Inference

user_stories.title: Data-Centric DataLoader: OFI + Spreads + Mid-Price
user_stories.description: Implement a Pandas-based loader. Calculate mid-price, bid-ask spreads, and Order Flow Imbalance (OFI). Normalize prices relative to mid-price. Output tensor MUST be exactly (batch, 1000, 32).
acceptance_criteria: Safely handles missing pyarrow filters using Pandas

user_stories.title: Vectorized Weighted Pearson Correlation Loss
user_stories.description: Implement a custom loss maximizing Weighted Pearson for (batch, 901, 2) shapes. Must include clipping to [-6, 6] and use absolute value of targets as weights.
acceptance_criteria: Uses torch.reshape instead of .view to avoid contiguous memory errors
Directly optimizes for the competition metric

user_stories.title: Goldilocks DeepLOB Architecture (PyTorch Native)
user_stories.description: Build DeepLOB: 1D CNNs -> 1-layer LSTM (hidden=64) -> Linear. DO NOT USE FOR-LOOPS in the forward pass. Must slice output to exactly (batch, 901, 2).

user_stories.title: Setup Sub-sampled Training Pipeline
user_stories.description: Create train.py. MUST limit sequences to 500 by default to prevent Mac freezing. Use AdamW, LR=0.005, batch_size=16.
acceptance_criteria: Saves best_model.pt based on validation loss

user_stories.title: Implement Exact Evaluation Metric
user_stories.description: Implement local Weighted Pearson evaluator to benchmark progress toward the >0.34 threshold.

user_stories.title: TorchScript Compilation & Export
user_stories.description: Write pt_export.py. Load best_model.pt, wrap it in torch.jit.script(), and save as model_jit.pt. Do NOT use ONNX.
acceptance_criteria: Successfully compiles the DeepLOB to C++ TorchScript
Saves model_jit.pt to the root directory

user_stories.title: Optimized PyTorch solution.py & prerun.py
user_stories.description: Write solution.py. Load 'model_jit.pt' via torch.jit.load. MUST use 'with torch.inference_mode():' and 'torch.set_num_threads(4)' to maximize CPU speed in the Docker container.
acceptance_criteria: prerun.py tests the model using torch.inference_mode()

user_stories.title: Strict PyTorch Packaging
user_stories.description: Package the final ZIP containing ONLY solution.py, model_jit.pt, and utils.py.
